data.name: ImplementInterface_Nothing
data.value: There is nothing to implement here: no Implements directive or WithEvents variable with members left to write.

data.name: ImplementInterface_DocumentChanged
data.value: The document has changed since the implementation was offered: ask for it again.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceRefusal_InvalidDirective
data.value: 'Implements {0}' is not a valid directive: its compile error says why.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceRefusal_Conditional
data.value: The members of '{0}' would be written in a branch of an #If block, and be compiled only when the branch is.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceRefusal_NotWritable
data.value: '{1}' has an Optional parameter whose default value its library does not state, so its implementation cannot be written.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceVerification_DoesNotParse
data.value: The members of '{0}' are not written: the module they would leave does not parse.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceVerification_Rebinds
data.value: The members of '{0}' are not written: '{1}' would no longer refer to what it refers to now.

data.name: ImplementInterfaceVerification_NewError
data.value: The members of '{0}' are not written: the module they would leave has a compile error it does not have now: {1}

data.name: ImplementInterfaceVerification_Incomplete
data.value: The members of '{0}' are not written: the module they would leave still does not implement '{1}'.
